name: airport-parking-index
title: Park & Keep airport parking index (Europe)
description: Car parks serving European airports, with their attributes and public prices for 3, 7 and 14-day stays read on each operator's own website. Airport aggregates (min / median / max) only from 3 prices.

sources.title: Websites and booking engines of each car park operator

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the listing in the Park & Keep comparator.

fields.name: airport_iata
fields.description: IATA code of the airport the car park serves.

fields.name: airport_city
fields.description: Airport name as shown on Park & Keep.

fields.name: airport_country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the airport.

fields.name: airport_vertical
fields.description: Comparator section (AIRPORT = airport parking).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the operator or car park.

fields.name: city
fields.description: Town of the car park.

fields.name: postal_code
fields.description: Postcode of the car park.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude (WGS 84).

fields.name: lng
fields.description: Longitude (WGS 84).

fields.name: distance_km
fields.description: Distance from the car park to the airport, in kilometres.

fields.name: shuttle
fields.description: Shuttle to the terminal offered (null = not stated by the operator).

fields.name: valet
fields.description: Valet / meet-and-greet offered (null = not stated).

fields.name: covered
fields.description: Covered or indoor parking offered (null = not stated).

fields.name: open_24h
fields.description: Open or accessible 24 hours a day (null = not stated).

fields.name: keys_kept
fields.description: Customer leaves the car keys with the operator (null = not stated).

fields.name: ev_charging
fields.description: Electric vehicle charging available (null = not stated).

fields.name: online_booking
fields.description: Online booking available (null = not stated).

fields.name: online_payment
fields.description: Online payment available (null = not stated).

fields.name: website
fields.description: Website of the operator.

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: Date the listing (name, location, attributes) was last checked.

fields.name: price_d3
fields.description: Public price of a 3-day stay, in price.currency (null = not collected).

fields.name: price_d7
fields.description: Public price of a 7-day stay, in price.currency (null = not collected).

fields.name: price_d14
fields.description: Public price of a 14-day stay, in price.currency (null = not collected).

fields.name: price_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency of the prices of this listing.

fields.name: price_source_url
fields.description: Page of the operator (website or its own booking engine) where the prices were read.

fields.name: price_checked_at
fields.description: Date the price page was read (or the listing was last passed to the survey).

fields.name: price_stay_start
fields.description: Start of the simulated stay for prices obtained as a booking quote (null for rate tables).

fields.name: price_method
fields.description: How the prices were read: html_text:<kind> = text of the operator's rate table; quote:<engine> = quote from the operator's own booking engine; "-" = page checked, no usable price; null = not surveyed.

resources.name: index
resources.description: Same listings nested, plus one aggregate row per airport (airports[]).
